WITH selected AS (
  SELECT
    {{ Number.isFinite(Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue || appsmith.store.ster_in_selected_item)) ? Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue || appsmith.store.ster_in_selected_item) : "NULL" }}::bigint AS item_id,
    {{ Number.isFinite(Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text || appsmith.store.ster_in_unit_size)) ? Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text || appsmith.store.ster_in_unit_size) : "NULL" }}::numeric AS unit_size_lb
),
selected_item AS (
  SELECT
    i.nocopk,
    lower(trim(COALESCE(i.component_mode, 'single_recipe'))) AS component_mode
  FROM public.items i
  JOIN selected s ON s.item_id = i.nocopk
),
recipe_options AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    r.nocopk::text AS option_value,
    r.name || CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(trim(r.recipe_id), '') IS NOT NULL THEN ' (' || r.recipe_id || ')'
      ELSE ''
    END AS option_label,
    'recipe'::text AS option_kind
  FROM selected s
  JOIN selected_item i ON true
  JOIN public.item_recipe_components irc
    ON irc.item_id = i.nocopk
   AND COALESCE(irc.active, false)
  JOIN public.recipes r
    ON r.nocopk = irc.recipe_id
   AND COALESCE(r.active, false)
  WHERE i.component_mode <> 'multi_recipe'
),
component_set_options AS (
  SELECT
    irc.component_set AS option_value,
    irc.component_set || ' — ' || string_agg(
      initcap(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(irc.component_role), ''), 'component')) || ': ' ||
      CASE
        WHEN irc.default_weight_lb IS NOT NULL
          THEN irc.default_weight_lb::text || ' lb '
        WHEN irc.default_percent IS NOT NULL
          THEN irc.default_percent::text || '% '
        ELSE ''
      END || COALESCE(r.name, r.recipe_id, 'Recipe'),
      ' + ' ORDER BY irc.component_role, r.name, r.recipe_id
    ) AS option_label,
    'component_set'::text AS option_kind
  FROM selected s
  JOIN selected_item i ON true
  JOIN public.item_recipe_components irc
    ON irc.item_id = i.nocopk
   AND COALESCE(irc.active, false)
  JOIN public.recipes r
    ON r.nocopk = irc.recipe_id
   AND COALESCE(r.active, false)
  WHERE i.component_mode = 'multi_recipe'
    AND s.unit_size_lb IS NOT NULL
    AND irc.unit_size_lb = s.unit_size_lb
    AND NULLIF(trim(irc.component_set), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY irc.component_set
)
SELECT option_value, option_label, option_kind
FROM recipe_options
UNION ALL
SELECT option_value, option_label, option_kind
FROM component_set_options
ORDER BY option_label;

  sr.nocopk,
  sr.steri_run_id,
  sr.process_type,
  sr.start_time,
  sr.operator,
  sr.planned_unit_size,
  sr.planned_count,
  i.name AS planned_item_name,
  i.category AS planned_item_category,
  COALESCE(r.name, sr.planned_component_set) AS planned_recipe_name
FROM public.sterilization_runs sr
LEFT JOIN public.items i ON i.nocopk = sr.planned_item_id
LEFT JOIN public.recipes r ON r.nocopk = sr.planned_recipe_id
WHERE sr.end_time IS NULL
ORDER BY sr.start_time DESC NULLS LAST, sr.nocopk DESC;

WITH lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,

    i.default_unit_size_g  AS item_default_unit_size_g,
    i.default_unit_size_oz AS item_default_unit_size_oz,
    i.default_unit_size_lb AS item_default_unit_size_lb,

    CASE
      WHEN l.harvest_weight_g IS NOT NULL AND l.harvest_weight_g::numeric > 0
        THEN l.harvest_weight_g::numeric
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.item_category_mat), ''), NULLIF(btrim(i.category), ''), ''))
           IN ('all_in_one_bag', 'casing', 'fruiting_block', 'grain', 'substrate')
           AND l.unit_size IS NOT NULL
           AND l.unit_size::numeric > 0
        THEN round((l.unit_size::numeric * 453.59237)::numeric, 2)
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_g IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_g::numeric > 0
        THEN i.default_unit_size_g::numeric
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_oz IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_oz::numeric > 0
        THEN round((i.default_unit_size_oz::numeric * 28.349523125)::numeric, 2)
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_lb IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_lb::numeric > 0
        THEN round((i.default_unit_size_lb::numeric * 453.59237)::numeric, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS packageable_weight_g

  FROM public.vc_lots l
  LEFT JOIN public.items i
    ON (
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(l.item_id::text, '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
          THEN l.item_id::bigint
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) = i.nocopk
    OR (
      COALESCE(l.item_id::text, '') <> ''
      AND i.item_id = l.item_id::text
    )
)

SELECT *
FROM lot_rows
WHERE 1=1
  AND (
    (
      NULLIF(BTRIM('{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.lot || "" }}'::text), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(lot_id::text, '')) = LOWER(BTRIM('{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.lot || "" }}'::text))
    )
    OR (
      (
        {{ inpLotType.selectedOptionValue === 'All' }}::boolean
        OR item_category_mat = ANY(
          string_to_array(NULLIF('{{ (LotsPage.lotTypeCategories() || []).join(",") }}'::text, ''), ',')
        )
      )
      AND (
        {{ inpLotStatus.selectedOptionValue === 'All' }}::boolean
        OR status = ANY(
          string_to_array(NULLIF('{{ (LotsPage.statusSet() || []).join(",") }}'::text, ''), ',')
        )
      )
      AND (
        {{ !(chkSterilized.isChecked || chkPasteurized.isChecked) }}::boolean
        OR (
          LOWER(COALESCE(process_type_mat::text,'')) = ANY(
            string_to_array(NULLIF('{{ (LotsPage.processTypeSet() || []).join(",") }}'::text, ''), ',')
          )
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(process_type_mat_from_substrate_inputs::text,'')) = ANY(
            string_to_array(NULLIF('{{ (LotsPage.processTypeSet() || []).join(",") }}'::text, ''), ',')
          )
        )
      )
      AND (
        {{ !(inpStrains.selectedOptionValue && inpStrains.selectedOptionValue !== 'All') }}::boolean
        OR strain_species_strain_mat = '{{ inpStrains.selectedOptionValue || "" }}'::text
      )
      AND (
        '{{ LotsPage.regulatedMode() || "all" }}'::text = 'all'
        OR (
          '{{ LotsPage.regulatedMode() || "all" }}'::text = 'regulated'
          AND TRUE = ANY(COALESCE(regulated_from_strain_id, ARRAY[FALSE]::boolean[]))
        )
        OR (
          '{{ LotsPage.regulatedMode() || "all" }}'::text = 'unregulated'
          AND NOT (TRUE = ANY(COALESCE(regulated_from_strain_id, ARRAY[FALSE]::boolean[])))
        )
      )
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM('{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.lot || "" }}'::text), '') IS NOT NULL
     AND LOWER(COALESCE(lot_id::text, '')) = LOWER(BTRIM('{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.lot || "" }}'::text))
      THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END,
  COALESCE(created_at, now()) DESC
LIMIT 2000;

SELECT
  i.nocopk,
  i.item_id,
  i.name,
  i.category,
  i.default_unit_size,
  i.default_unit_size_ml,
  COALESCE(i.active, true) AS active,
  trim(
    concat_ws(
      ' ',
      NULLIF(i.name, ''),
      CASE
        WHEN i.default_unit_size_ml IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || i.default_unit_size_ml::text || ' ml)'
        WHEN i.default_unit_size IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || i.default_unit_size::text || ')'
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(i.item_id, '') IS NOT NULL THEN '— ' || i.item_id
        ELSE NULL
      END
    )
  ) AS label
FROM public.items i
WHERE COALESCE(i.active, true)
  AND (
    lower(COALESCE(i.category, '')) IN ('lc_syringe', 'syringe', 'lc-syringe')
    OR lower(COALESCE(i.category, '')) LIKE '%syringe%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(i.name, '')) LIKE '%syringe%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(i.item_id, '')) LIKE '%syringe%'
  )
ORDER BY
  lower(COALESCE(i.name, '')),
  i.default_unit_size_ml NULLS LAST,
  i.nocopk;

SELECT
  i.nocopk,
  i.item_id,

  i.category,
  i.default_unit_size,
  i.default_unit_size_ml,
  COALESCE(i.active, true) AS active,
  trim(
    concat_ws(
      ' ',
      NULLIF(i.name, ''),
      CASE
        WHEN i.default_unit_size_ml IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || i.default_unit_size_ml::text || ' ml)'
        WHEN i.default_unit_size IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || i.default_unit_size::text || ')'
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(i.item_id, '') IS NOT NULL THEN '— ' || i.item_id
        ELSE NULL
      END
    )
  ) AS label
FROM public.items i
WHERE COALESCE(i.active, true)
  AND (
    lower(COALESCE(i.category, '')) IN ('lc_syringe', 'syringe', 'lc-syringe')
    OR lower(COALESCE(i.category, '')) LIKE '%syringe%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(i.name, '')) LIKE '%syringe%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(i.item_id, '')) LIKE '%syringe%'
  )
ORDER BY

  i.default_unit_size_ml NULLS LAST,
  i.nocopk;

WITH ui_raw AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsSpawnToBulk.sql.str(
        inpStrains.selectedOptionValue && inpStrains.selectedOptionValue !== 'All'
          ? inpStrains.selectedOptionValue
          : 'All'
      ) }}::text,
      'All'
    ) AS selected_strain_raw,

    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsSpawnToBulk.sql.str((() => {
        const r = !!chkRegulated.isChecked;
        const u = !!chkUnRegulated.isChecked;

        if ((r && u) || (!r && !u)) return 'all';
        return r ? 'regulated' : 'unregulated';
      })()) }}::text,
      'all'
    ) AS regulated_mode_raw
),
ui AS (
  SELECT
    trim(both '''' from selected_strain_raw) AS selected_strain,
    trim(both '''' from regulated_mode_raw) AS regulated_mode
  FROM ui_raw
),
lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.nocopk,
    l.lot_id,
    l.item_name_mat,
    l.item_category_mat,
    l.strain_id,
    l.strain_species_strain_mat,
    l.regulated_from_strain_id,

    CASE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id::text ILIKE '%true%' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_regulated,

    l.vendor_name_mat,
    l.status,
    l.qty,
    l.unit_size,
    l.created_at,
    l.inoculated_at,
    loc.name AS storage_location
  FROM public.vc_lots l
  LEFT JOIN public.locations loc
    ON loc.nocopk = l.location_id
  WHERE regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.item_category_mat, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'grain'
    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(l.strain_species_strain_mat, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
      'colonizing',
      'colonized',
      'fullycolonized',
      'fridge',
      'colonizedfridge'
    )
    AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') NOT IN (
      'retired',
      'consumed',
      'compost',
      'composted',
      'expired',
      'deleted',
      'spoiled'
    )
)

SELECT
  lr.nocopk,

  lr.item_name_mat,
  lr.item_category_mat,
  lr.strain_id,
  lr.strain_species_strain_mat,

LIMIT 500;

WITH events_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    e.lot_id,
    e.type,
    e.event_time_for_rollup AS t,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(e.fields_json::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS fj,
    l.strain_species_strain_mat AS species,
    l.item_name_mat_from_grain_inputs AS grain_txt,
    l.item_name_mat_from_substrate_inputs AS substrate_inputs_txt
  FROM public.vc_events e
  LEFT JOIN public.vc_lots l ON l.nocopk = e.lot_id
),
harvests AS (
  SELECT
    lot_id,
    date_trunc('month', t) AS month,
    COALESCE((fj->>'harvest_weight_g')::numeric, 0) AS harvest_g,
    MAX(species) AS species,
    MAX(substrate_inputs_txt) AS substrate_txt
  FROM events_normalized
  WHERE type = 'Harvest'
    AND (fj ? 'harvest_weight_g')
  GROUP BY lot_id, date_trunc('month', t), COALESCE((fj->>'harvest_weight_g')::numeric, 0)
)
SELECT
  month,
  SUM(harvest_g) AS total_harvest_g
FROM harvests
WHERE month >= COALESCE(NULLIF({{ dpStart.selectedDate || "" }}::text, '')::timestamp, now() - interval '365 days')
  AND month <  COALESCE(NULLIF({{ dpEnd.selectedDate || "" }}::text, '')::timestamp, now() + interval '1 day')
  AND (NULLIF({{ selSpecies.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL OR species = {{ selSpecies.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text)
  AND (NULLIF({{ selSubstrate.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL OR substrate_txt ILIKE ('%' || {{ selSubstrate.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text || '%'))
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

    WHEN spawned_to_bulk_at IS NOT NULL AND fruiting_start_at IS NOT NULL
      THEN (fruiting_start_at - spawned_to_bulk_at)
  END AS time_to_fruit_after_bulk

SELECT
  l.*,
  CASE
    WHEN concat_ws(
      ' ',
      COALESCE(l.item_name_mat::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.recipe_name::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.item_id::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.recipe_id::text, '')
    ) ILIKE ANY (string_to_array('%cvg%,%coco verm%,%coir%', ','))
      THEN 'CVG'
    WHEN concat_ws(
      ' ',
      COALESCE(l.item_name_mat::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.recipe_name::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.item_id::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.recipe_id::text, '')
    ) ILIKE ANY (string_to_array('%hardwood%,%masters mix%,%master''s mix%,%mm50%,%mm75%', ','))
      THEN 'Hardwood'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS substrate_group
FROM public.vc_lots l
WHERE regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.item_category_mat::text, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'substrate'
  AND l.spawned_at IS NULL
  AND l.inoculated_at IS NULL
  AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status::text, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
    'new',
    'planned',
    'sterilized',
    'pasteurized',
    'sealed'
  )
  AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status::text, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') NOT IN (
    'spawned',
    'colonizing',
    'fullycolonized',
    'colonized',
    'fruiting',
    'frozen',
    'coldshock',
    'retired',
    'consumed',
    'compost',
    'composted',
    'expired',
    'deleted',
    'spoiled'
  )
ORDER BY COALESCE(l.sterilized_at, l.created_at, now()) DESC, l.nocopk DESC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH ui_raw AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsHarvest.sql.str(
        inpStrains.selectedOptionValue && inpStrains.selectedOptionValue !== 'All'
          ? inpStrains.selectedOptionValue
          : 'All'
      ) }}::text,
      'All'
    ) AS selected_strain_raw,

    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsHarvest.sql.str((() => {
        const r = !!chkRegulated.isChecked;
        const u = !!chkUnRegulated.isChecked;

        if ((r && u) || (!r && !u)) return 'all';
        return r ? 'regulated' : 'unregulated';
      })()) }}::text,
      'all'
    ) AS regulated_mode_raw
),
ui AS (
  SELECT
    trim(both '''' from selected_strain_raw) AS selected_strain,
    trim(both '''' from regulated_mode_raw) AS regulated_mode
  FROM ui_raw
),
lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,

    CASE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id::text ILIKE '%true%' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_regulated
  FROM public.vc_lots l
  WHERE regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.item_category_mat, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
      'fruitingblock',
      'cordycepssubstrate',
      'allinonebag'
    )
    AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
      'fruiting',
      'colonizing',
      'spawned',
      'fullycolonized'
    )
)

SELECT
  lr.*
FROM lot_rows lr
CROSS JOIN ui
WHERE (
    ui.selected_strain = 'All'
    OR ui.selected_strain = ''
    OR lr.strain_species_strain_mat = ui.selected_strain
  )
  AND (
    ui.regulated_mode = 'all'
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'regulated' AND lr.is_regulated = TRUE)
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'unregulated' AND lr.is_regulated = FALSE)
  )
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(lr.spawned_at, lr.inoculated_at, lr.created_at, now()) DESC,
  lr.nocopk DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  i.nocopk,
  i.item_id,
  i.name,
  i.category,
  i.default_unit_size,
  i.default_unit_size_ml,
  COALESCE(i.active, true) AS active,
  trim(
    concat_ws(
      ' ',
      NULLIF(i.name, ''),
      CASE
        WHEN i.default_unit_size_ml IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || i.default_unit_size_ml::text || ' ml)'
        WHEN i.default_unit_size IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || i.default_unit_size::text || ')'
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(i.item_id, '') IS NOT NULL THEN '— ' || i.item_id
        ELSE NULL
      END
    )
  ) AS label
FROM public.items i
WHERE COALESCE(i.active, true)
  AND (

    'missingorlost', 'shipped', 'consumed', 'expired', 'compost', 'retired'
  )

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(
      btrim(
        '{{ (inpReconProductNumber.text || "").replace(/''/g, "''''").trim() }}'
      ),
      ''
    )::text AS search_text
),

inventory AS (

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------
     PRODUCTS
     --------------------------------------------------------- */
  SELECT
    'Product'::text AS inventory_type,
    ('product:' || p.nocopk::text) AS entity_key,
    p.product_id::text AS inventory_id,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(i.name, ''),
      NULLIF(p.name_mat, ''),
      p.product_id
    )::text AS name,

    s.species_strain::text AS species_strain,
    loc.name::text AS storage_location,
    NULL::text AS vendor_name,
    p.item_category_mat::text AS item_category,

    CASE
      WHEN p.product_id ILIKE params.search_text
        THEN 0
      WHEN p.product_id ILIKE params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 1
      WHEN p.product_id ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 2
      WHEN COALESCE(i.name, p.name_mat, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 3
      WHEN COALESCE(s.species_strain, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 4
      WHEN COALESCE(p.item_category_mat, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 5
      ELSE 99
    END AS match_rank

  FROM public.products p

  LEFT JOIN public.items i
    ON i.nocopk = p.item_id

  LEFT JOIN public.locations loc
    ON loc.nocopk = p.storage_location_id

  LEFT JOIN public.strains s
    ON s.nocopk = p.strain_id

  CROSS JOIN params

  WHERE
    params.search_text IS NOT NULL
    AND length(params.search_text) >= 2
    AND CONCAT_WS(
      ' ',
      p.product_id,
      i.name,
      p.name_mat,
      s.species_strain,
      p.item_category_mat,
      loc.name
    ) ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'


  UNION ALL


  /* ---------------------------------------------------------
     LOTS
     --------------------------------------------------------- */
  SELECT
    'Lot'::text AS inventory_type,
    ('lot:' || lot.nocopk::text) AS entity_key,
    lot.lot_id::text AS inventory_id,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(i.name, ''),
      NULLIF(lot.item_name_mat, ''),
      lot.lot_id
    )::text AS name,

    s.species_strain::text AS species_strain,
    loc.name::text AS storage_location,
    lot.vendor_name::text AS vendor_name,
    lot.item_category_mat::text AS item_category,

    CASE
      WHEN lot.lot_id ILIKE params.search_text
        THEN 0
      WHEN lot.lot_id ILIKE params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 1
      WHEN lot.lot_id ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 2
      WHEN COALESCE(i.name, lot.item_name_mat, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 3
      WHEN COALESCE(s.species_strain, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 4
      WHEN COALESCE(lot.vendor_name, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 5
      WHEN COALESCE(lot.item_category_mat, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 6
      ELSE 99
    END AS match_rank

  FROM public.lots lot

  LEFT JOIN public.items i
    ON i.nocopk = lot.item_id

  LEFT JOIN public.locations loc
    ON loc.nocopk = lot.location_id

  LEFT JOIN public.strains s
    ON s.nocopk = lot.strain_id

  CROSS JOIN params

  WHERE
    params.search_text IS NOT NULL
    AND length(params.search_text) >= 2
    AND CONCAT_WS(
      ' ',
      lot.lot_id,
      i.name,
      lot.item_name_mat,
      s.species_strain,
      lot.vendor_name,
      lot.item_category_mat,
      loc.name
    ) ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
)

SELECT
  entity_key AS id,
  inventory_type,
  inventory_id,
  name,
  species_strain,
  storage_location,
  vendor_name,
  item_category,

  CONCAT_WS(
    ' · ',
    inventory_type,
    inventory_id,
    NULLIF(name, ''),
    NULLIF(species_strain, ''),
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(vendor_name, '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Vendor: ' || vendor_name
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(storage_location, '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Location: ' || storage_location
    END
  ) AS label

FROM inventory

ORDER BY
  match_rank,
  inventory_type,
  inventory_id

LIMIT 30;

      WHEN lot.lot_id ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 2
      WHEN COALESCE(i.name, lot.item_name_mat, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 3
      WHEN COALESCE(s.species_strain, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 4
      WHEN COALESCE(lot.vendor_name, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 5
      WHEN COALESCE(lot.item_category_mat, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 6
      ELSE 99
    END AS match_rank

  FROM public.lots lot

  LEFT JOIN public.items i
    ON i.nocopk = lot.item_id

  LEFT JOIN public.locations loc
    ON loc.nocopk = lot.location_id

  LEFT JOIN public.strains s
    ON s.nocopk = lot.strain_id

  CROSS JOIN params

  WHERE
    params.search_text IS NOT NULL
    AND length(params.search_text) >= 2
    AND CONCAT_WS(
      ' ',
      lot.lot_id,
      i.name,
      lot.item_name_mat,
      s.species_strain,
      lot.vendor_name,
      lot.item_category_mat,
      loc.name
    ) ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
)

SELECT
  entity_key AS id,
  inventory_type,
  inventory_id,
  name,
  species_strain,
  storage_location,
  vendor_name,
  item_category,

  CONCAT_WS(
    ' · ',
    inventory_type,
    inventory_id,
    NULLIF(name, ''),
    NULLIF(species_strain, ''),
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(vendor_name, '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Vendor: ' || vendor_name
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(storage_location, '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Location: ' || storage_location
    END
  ) AS label

FROM inventory

ORDER BY
  match_rank,
  inventory_type,
  inventory_id

LIMIT 30;
